name: Fleet Master Seahorn
summary: From Booty Bay, Fleet Master Seahorn guards the harbor against the Bloodsail Buccaneers. The seasoned tauren commands the Blackwater Raiders from the Salty Sailor Tavern, beside Baron Revilgaz.

sections.title: A Bull on the High Seas
sections.body: Fleet Master Seahorn commands the Blackwater Raiders from the Salty Sailor Tavern. Though many tauren across Kalimdor live on the plains, Seahorn chose the sea and wears pirate regalia. The Raiders serve as the Steamwheedle Cartel's private navy in Stranglethorn Vale. From his post above Booty Bay, Seahorn works with Baron Revilgaz to direct shipping routes, crew deployments, and coastal defenses for a port both lawless and tightly managed.

sections.title: Defending the Bay
sections.body: Bloodsail Buccaneers threaten Booty Bay from fortified camps along the southern Wild Shore and from warships offshore. Reports reveal that Fleet Master Firallon and the Bloodsail leaders plan a direct assault to sack the port. Seahorn answers with force. He sends mercenaries to seize enemy correspondence and neutralize Firallon, Keelhaul, and Stillwater aboard their flagship. The move shields Booty Bay from outright devastation.

sections.title: Eyes Across the Seas
sections.body: Seahorn oversees trade and salvage ventures across the Eastern Kingdoms. Near Faldir's Cove on the Arathi coast, he coordinates the recovery of sunken treasures and works with salvage divers to secure elven relics. He also keeps Revilgaz informed of profitable opportunities in town, including competitive angling and local trade. These ventures help fund the Blackwater fleet and keep it ahead of rivals.

faq.q: Where is Fleet Master Seahorn located?
faq.answer: Fleet Master Seahorn keeps to the top floor and balcony of the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay. He stands beside Baron Revilgaz, overlooking the docks.

faq.q: Why is a tauren serving as a pirate fleet master?
faq.answer: Seahorn chose a seafaring, mercenary naval life despite the plains traditions of many tauren in Mulgore. His nautical skill and commanding presence earned him leadership of the Blackwater Raiders under Baron Revilgaz.

faq.q: What is Seahorn's relationship with Baron Revilgaz?
faq.answer: Seahorn is Baron Revilgaz's second-in-command and commands the Blackwater Raiders at sea. Revilgaz handles politics, trade, and finances, while Seahorn oversees the fleet, tactical intelligence, and Booty Bay's defenses.

The Blackwater Raiders are a private fleet of corsairs loyal to the Steamwheedle Cartel and based in Booty Bay. They are a sanctioned navy, protecting goblin merchants and maintaining order in the southern seas, unlike outlaw raiders who plunder without restraint.

faq.q: Why does Seahorn want to stop the Bloodsail Buccaneers?
faq.answer: The Bloodsail Buccaneers are bitter rivals of the Blackwater Raiders. Led by Fleet Master Firallon, they have camps along the Wild Shore and intend to conquer Booty Bay. Seahorn works to get ahead of their invasion plans.

faq.q: Does Seahorn have dealings outside of Stranglethorn Vale?
faq.answer: Yes. Seahorn works with salvage agents such as Doctor Draxlegauge and Shakes O'Breen to recover lost cargo and elven treasures sunk near Faldir's Cove off the Arathi Highlands. Valuable artifacts are delivered to his post in Booty Bay.

angles.text: As a tauren, you share a homeland with one of the rare few who left Kalimdor's inland plains to master the open ocean and serve a neutral goblin port.
Though Seahorn is a tauren, his allegiance belongs to the Steamwheedle Cartel and the Blackwater Raiders. He remains neutral toward Horde and Alliance travelers alike.
As a rogue in Booty Bay, you may find Seahorn coordinating coastal espionage, covert raids against Bloodsail warships, and efforts to intercept enemy orders.
